purpose: Portable copies of the frozen experiment states that the AI regression tests need. Extracted verbatim from the local ai-training/ authorities (git-ignored by repository policy, .gitignore ai-training/), so a fresh GitHub clone can run the suite without that directory.
extractionRule: Only the HardRootSnapshot game-affecting fields are kept; debug-only state fields (catActionLog, gameEventLog, lastHardSearch, hardSearchHistory, message) are dropped. Every record carries the authority stateKey (or the timeline scalars it cross-checks against) plus a sha256 over the canonical snapshot JSON.
